texts: Welcome from the MindHealth team! We’re a small but highly inspired group, and yes — we really do all fit in that photo together.

We’re a married couple from Finland. Daniil is the developer who personally wrote every single line of code in the app. Sofya is the designer who made MindHealth not only beautiful but also intuitive to use. And in the center is our little source of inspiration, Toothless, a bearded dragon who brings us smiles every single day.

In addition to us, we work with professionals who support us in specific areas, including psychologists, content authors, and other specialists. We bring them on board to ensure our content is high-quality and reliable.

We’ve navigated our own difficult journey with depression, which became one of the main reasons we created MindHealth. We wanted to build a tool that helps others get through tough times with a bit more ease and confidence.
We created this page to feel closer to you. If you’re interested, we’ll be happy to share updates on the project’s development and little glimpses into our lives.
For a long time, we developed the app in our spare time, but we recently made the important decision to dedicate ourselves fully to the project and leave our main jobs.
While MindHealth doesn’t provide our full income yet, we have a financial cushion and the confidence that we can navigate this stage.
We continue to develop MindHealth every day, and we sincerely hope it becomes a helpful tool for supporting your mental well-being.
